Class JdbcCatDao

java.lang.Object
dao.jdbc.JdbcCatDao
All Implemented Interfaces:
CatDao
public class JdbcCatDao extends Object implements CatDao
JDBC implementation of CatDao. Connects to a relational database to perform cat CRUD operations.
